name: Super DD Template
ground_rules: **Every number carries a source.** Put a `Source:` line under each block (his habit) or a source column in the figure. A number with no source is cut or marked `UNVERIFIED`.

**Dates are verified or absent.** Earnings, FOMC, CPI, deal deadlines: company IR, an SEC filing, or the Fed's own calendar. Aggregator dates are not enough. If it can't be verified, write "date not confirmed" and leave the date out.

**Unadjusted prices for levels, adjusted prices for returns.** yfinance `history()` is dividend-adjusted by default; use `auto_adjust=False` for any level a reader will place an order against. Check whether the last session was an ex-dividend date before calling a move a "selloff."
**Re-pull, don't inherit.** Numbers from a prior debate, dossier, or memory get re-pulled on the day of writing. When the re-pull disagrees, say which one you used and why.
**Opinion is labeled.** Sections 1 to 11 are evidence. Sections 12 to 15 are the call.
**Voice:** VOICE.md applies. No em/en dashes, no markdown tables in Substack (images instead; the TraderMatrix blog renders GFM tables but images still read better on a phone).

sections.title: The pitch (top of post)
sections.question: in two sentences, what is this and why am I looking at it today?

fields.item: One-line pitch: "${COMPANY} (${TICKER}) is a ${what}. ${why now}." (his format)
Score /10, size in R, and the one-word action (BUY ON TRIGGER / WAIT / SKIP), up front
Price and date of the data (YF)
Origin story if one exists (VOICE.md "life as alt-data")

sections.title: Business and management
sections.question: what does it sell, to whom, and who is steering?

fields.item: Segments with revenue and op profit (SEC 10-Q segment note)
End markets and their growth rates (earnings call transcript, WEB; quote the speaker)
CEO and CFO, named from the filing signature block or press release (SEC/IR). Bios only with a source.
Employees, market cap (YF)

sections.title: The numbers
sections.question: is the business getting better or worse, and how fast?

fields.item: Latest quarter vs year-ago: revenue, gross margin, op profit, EPS (SEC 8-K Ex.99)
TTM operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow (SEC 8-K Ex.99)
Guidance range for next quarter (SEC 8-K Ex.99)
Balance sheet: cash + short-term investments, total debt, current ratio (SEC 10-Q, YF)
Inventory and days of inventory (SEC 10-Q MD&A)
Dividend, payout ratio, buyback pace (SEC, YF). Check if buybacks have slowed and why.
Earnings surprise history, last 4 to 8 quarters (YF `earnings_dates`)
Composite scores 0-100: value, growth, quality, sentiment (Deep Dive spec section 4), plus TDPro quality score (`get_ticker_snapshot`)

sections.title: Filing read (10-Q / 10-K / 8-K / S-series / 424B)
sections.question: what does the company say in writing that the headlines missed?

fields.item: Pull the filing index for the last 3 to 6 months (SEC). Read every 8-K item code, every 424B5/FWP (debt or equity raise), every S-4 (merger).
From the 10-Q: Item 1A changes (or "incorporated by reference"), subsequent events, acquisitions, credit facilities, legal proceedings, segment shifts
Capital allocation outlook (capex range, CHIPS or other subsidies)
Write down anything the bull/bear debate or the screen did not know. This section exists because it catches things (TXN: a pending $7.5B acquisition and $2B of new notes).

sections.title: News, last 6 months
sections.question: what happened, in order, and did price lead or follow?

fields.item: `[event, date] + 2-3 line takeaway + Source` (his format)
Price reaction the next session for each event (YF). News follows price: note when the move came before the story.
TDP `get_ticker_news` for the catalyst filter; WEB for depth

sections.title: Growth drivers
sections.question: what has to keep going right?

fields.item: Each driver with a number (segment growth, share of revenue, pricing, new capacity)
Source each one

sections.title: Risks
sections.question: what breaks the thesis, and which of those are dated?

fields.item: Market/cyclical, execution/financing, regulatory/geopolitical, concentration
Each with a source and, where possible, a date it could hit
Pending deal risk: spread between target price and deal price (YF), regulator status (WEB)

sections.title: Competition and correlation
sections.question: who does it trade with, and who does it lose to?

fields.item: Peer table: fwd P/E, op margin, revenue growth, YTD (YF)
Daily-return correlation 63d and 126d to peers, sector ETF, SPY, and any name with its own binary event this month (YF)
Beta to SPY and to the sector ETF (YF)
Where it wins vs each competitor, where it loses (WEB, filings)
Peer catalyst dates (verified only): a 0.9-correlated peer's earnings is this name's event

sections.title: Sentiment and positioning (people)
sections.question: what are the Street, insiders, and Congress doing?

fields.item: Analyst count, consensus, mean/median/low/high target (YF); last 30 days of rating and target changes (YF `upgrades_downgrades`)
Insider transactions, 21 days and 6 months: name, title, code (P vs S vs S+OE), value, % of stake (TDP `get_insider_trades` with `direction: all`; cross-check SEC Form 4/144)
Politician trades (TDP `get_politician_trades_by_ticker`)
Retail chatter (Stocktwits MCP, named handles if quoting)

sections.title: Options and flow (dealers and size)
sections.question: where are the walls, is premium rich or cheap, and is size moving?

fields.item: Gamma regime, flip level, dominant strike, call walls, put walls (TDP `get_gex_ticker`, `get_apex_levels`). If two models disagree on the flip, print both.
Expected move ladder 1d/1w/1m/6w with hold rates (TDP `get_expected_move`)
IV rank (TDP `get_iv_rank`), HV30 and its 1-year range (YF), implied vs realized
Unusual options activity, last session (TDP `get_unusual_activity`, `timeFrame: todayOrLastSession`)
Dark pool block flow 5d and 30d (TDP `get_dark_pool`). Check `failed` and `truncated`. Zero prints on a mega-cap is a coverage question, not a signal.
Short interest, days to cover, daily short ratio (TDP `get_short_interest`)
Option chain quotes for the proposed structure, bid/ask/mid/OI (YF `option_chain`)

sections.title: Chart and technicals
sections.question: where is price in its own structure?

fields.item: Chart image with dealer levels: `node .claude/skills/stock-recap/scripts/render_chart.mjs TICKER --out DIR --days 300`. Read the PNG before using it.
EMA 8/21/34/55/89 stack, SMA 20/50/100/200, % over 200-day (YF, unadjusted)
RSI(14), MACD, ADX(14) with +DI/-DI (ADX has no direction; say which DI leads)
ATR(14) and ATR(20); pivots; Keltner; Fib on the 52-week range (YF)
52-week high/low with dates, 20-day high/low, trend structure (HH/HL or range)
Is it extended, ranging, or breaking a falling trendline? (his #1 setup)
Levels map figure: every level, what it is, and its source

sections.title: Sector and macro
sections.question: is the tide in or out?

fields.item: Benchmark table 1w/1m/3m/6m/YTD/1y for the ticker, sector ETF, SPY, QQQ (YF)
Macro dates that matter this month, verified (Fed calendar, BLS)
Market regime (TDP `get_market_health`, `get_macro_regime`)

sections.title: Valuation
sections.question: what am I paying, against itself and against peers?

fields.item: Market cap, trailing and forward P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/S, FCF yield, dividend yield (YF)
Graham / Lynch / analyst blend and the valuation gap (Deep Dive spec section 3)
Ownership split institutional/insider (YF)

sections.title: Steelman: bull vs bear
sections.question: what is the best honest case on each side?

fields.item: Three to five points each, the strongest version, with numbers
What each side concedes (if a multi-agent debate was run, cite where scores moved)

sections.title: What would make me wrong
sections.question: at what price or event do I stop believing this?

fields.item: Price invalidation level(s) with reason
Event invalidation (guide cut, deal blocked, peer print)
Thesis-break vs trade-break: the trade can stop out while the thesis survives. Say which.

sections.title: Catalyst calendar
sections.question: what is dated between now and the expiry I'm buying?

fields.item: Only verified dates, each with its source. Unverified ones listed without a date.
Company: earnings, dividend dates, investor/capital calls, deal deadlines, note settlements
Peers with correlation > 0.7, plus any name with its own binary event (NVDA etc.)
Macro: FOMC, CPI, opex

sections.title: Trade plan
sections.question: exactly what do I do, and how big?

fields.item: Score /10, conviction, and size in R (and what sleeve it shares risk with)
Trigger(s): price + condition (limit fill vs daily close). No-trade zone stated.
Stop: level, close vs intraday, distance in ATR (flag stops under 1 ATR)
Targets: T1, T2 with R multiple from the trigger
Options expression: structure, expiry, strikes, live bid/ask/mid, debit, max value, breakeven, R:R on the debit. Expiry must clear every dated catalyst in section 15.
Wheeler alternative: the CSP strike, premium, effective basis, and whether it fits the current list's rules
Exit triggers that are not price (thesis break from section 14)
What I might have missed; invite readers to say so (his close)
Sign-off `~ Michael`, then one line: not financial advice
Source list with raw URLs
